# search tools

Semantic and full-text code search across repositories

16 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `analyze_graph`

Multi-file, whole-repository graph analysis -- builds a real CSR reference graph across every file in the repo, then runs your Rust evaluator's fn analyze_graph over the whole graph. Use for cross-file questions single-file AST search (xray_search) cannot answer: dead code, unreachable/unwired components, layering violations, endpoint-to-sink reachability, blast radius.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [search/analyze_graph.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/search/analyze_graph.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string or array of string | yes | Repository identifier(s) to analyze. |
| `evaluator_code` | string | no | Inline Rust graph evaluator defining TWO REQUIRED functions: fn collect_facts(...) and fn analyze_graph(...). |
| `pattern_name` | string | no | Stored graph-mode pattern name to resolve from the X-Ray pattern library. |
| `pattern_params` | object | no | Optional typed parameter overrides for the stored graph pattern, using the same substitution semantics as xray_search. |
| `include_patterns` | array of string | no | Glob patterns for files to include in the graph (e.g. ["\*.java", "\*.kt"]). |
| `exclude_patterns` | array of string | no | Glob patterns for files to exclude from the graph (e.g. ["\*/test/\*", "\*/vendor/\*"]). |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | no | Wall-clock timeout in seconds for the WHOLE pipeline (repo-alias resolution, file collection, evaluator compile, --build-graph, --analyze-graph, and --refine when refine=true). |
| `refine` | boolean | no | Opt-in: when true AND your analyze_graph populated a non-empty GraphResult.refine, runs the optional refine phase as a THIRD subprocess -- a real per-file AST pass over exactly the files a flagged... |
| `await_seconds` | number | no | Reserved for future async job-polling parity with xray_search. |

## `search_code`

Search code using pre-built indexes.

| `language` | string | no | Filter by programming language name or extension (e.g., 'python', 'py', 'js', 'typescript'). |
| `exclude_language` | string | no | Exclude files of specified language. |
| `path_filter` | string | no | Filter by file path using glob syntax (e.g., '\*/tests/\*', '\*/src/\*\*/\*.py'). |

| `snippet_lines` | integer | no | Context lines around FTS matches (0=list only, 1-50). |
| `regex` | boolean | no | Interpret query as regex pattern. |
| `diff_type` | string | no | Filter temporal results by diff type (added/modified/deleted/renamed/binary). |
| `author` | string | no | Filter temporal results by commit author name or email. |
| `chunk_type` | string (one of: `commit_message`, `commit_diff`) | no | Filter temporal results: 'commit_message' or 'commit_diff'. |
| `temporal_embedder` | string | no | Explicit temporal embedder override (e.g. 'embed-v4.0'). |
| `query_strategy` | string (one of: `primary_only`, `failover`, `parallel`, `specific`) | no | Query strategy: primary_only, failover (switch on failure — API error or timeout, not empty results), parallel (score fusion across both providers), specific (use one named provider). |
| `score_fusion` | string (one of: `rrf`, `multiply`, `average`) | no | Score fusion method for parallel strategy (default: rrf). 'rrf' (Reciprocal Rank Fusion): rank-position-based, immune to score-scale differences between providers. 'multiply'/'average': raw score... |
| `preferred_provider` | string (one of: `voyage-ai`, `cohere`) | no | Embedding provider to use when query_strategy='specific'. |
| `response_format` | string (one of: `flat`, `grouped`) | no | Multi-repo result format. 'flat' (default): single array with source_repo field per result. 'grouped': results organized under results_by_repo by repository. |
| `rerank_query` | string | no | Query for cross-encoder reranking. |
| `rerank_instruction` | string | no | Optional instruction prefix for the reranker (e.g. 'Find implementation, not tests'). |
| `no_embedding_cache_shortcut` | boolean | no | When true, skip the query-embedding cache read for this request (the write still occurs so future requests benefit). |

| `pattern_yaml` | string | yes | YAML string defining the pattern. |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | When false (default), returns pattern_already_exists error if a pattern with the same name already exists in the given scope. |

## `xray_explore`

Debug-mode X-Ray search -- same two-phase driver+evaluator as xray_search but enriches every match with a serialised AST tree so you can understand the node structure tree-sitter produces for your code. Evaluator is Rust native code (fn evaluate_node).

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [search/xray_explore.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/search/xray_explore.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string or array of string | yes | Repository identifier(s). |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Regular expression applied in Phase 1 to file content (search_target=content) or relative file paths (search_target=filename) to identify candidate files. |
| `evaluator_code` | string | no | Rust code defining fn evaluate_node(node: &OwnedNode) -&gt; Vec&lt;EvalFinding&gt;. |
| `search_target` | string (one of: `content`, `filename`) | yes | What pattern applies to: "content" matches file text, "filename" matches relative file paths. |
| `include_patterns` | array of string | no | Glob patterns for files to include (e.g. ["\*.java", "\*.kt"]). |
| `exclude_patterns` | array of string | no | Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g. ["\*/test/\*"]). |
| `path` | string | no | Subdirectory within the repository to restrict the Phase 1 content driver to (relative to repo root). null/omitted means the full repository. |
| `case_sensitive` | boolean | no | Case-sensitive matching for the Phase 1 content driver regex. |
| `context_lines` | integer | no | Lines of context before/after each Phase 1 hit. |
| `multiline` | boolean | no | Enable multi-line regex matching in the Phase 1 content driver. |
| `pcre2` | boolean | no | Enable PCRE2 engine for advanced features (lookahead, lookbehind) in the Phase 1 content driver. |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | no | Per-job wall-clock timeout in seconds. |
| `max_debug_nodes` | integer | no | Maximum number of AST nodes to include in the ast_debug payload for each match. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of candidate files to evaluate. |
| `await_seconds` | number | no | Optional server-side polling window in seconds (floats accepted, e.g. 2.5). |
| `pattern_name` | string | no | Name of a stored xray evaluator pattern to use (from the cidx-meta pattern library). |
| `pattern_params` | object | no | JSON object of parameter overrides for the resolved pattern. |

## `xray_search_batch`

Cross-repo, multi-expression X-Ray sweep -- one background job fans out over N repositories x M scan bundles, returns a single job_id, and produces a unified tagged result.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [search/xray_search_batch.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/search/xray_search_batch.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string or array of string | yes | Repository identifier(s): single string, list of strings, or JSON-encoded string array. |
| `scans` | array of object | yes | Array of scan bundles (REQUIRED, non-empty, max 50). |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Per-cell file cap (passed to the engine as max_files). |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | no | Whole-matrix wall-clock cap in seconds. |
| `await_seconds` | number | no | Server-side inline-wait window in seconds. |
